name: Camping 101: First Aid

aliases: who to talk to camping first aid
faq.answer: Speak with Naleeia Tattermend in Shen'dar Village. She knows how to craft medical supplies for wilderness camps.
faq.q: Who do I need to speak with for this quest?

faq.answer: Shen'dar Village is on Zephras Isle, where Naleeia Tattermend lives. Practitioners travel there for further wilderness first aid training after honing their skills.

aliases: what does camping first aid do
faq.answer: You learn to make a First Aid Kit for an adventurer's campsite. Supplies ready at camp let you treat injuries between journeys. They may mean the difference between life and death.
faq.q: What is the purpose of crafting a First Aid Kit for camp?

aliases: when can i learn the first aid kit
faq.answer: Naleeia Tattermend teaches you after you show enough skill in First Aid. Practice bandaging and treatment before making field kits.
faq.q: When will Naleeia Tattermend teach me to craft the kit?

faq.answer: Wounds and physical trauma threaten travelers across Azeroth. Bandages and medical care let travelers of every discipline tend their own wounds and stabilize companions without relying only on magic.
faq.q: Why is First Aid considered both honorable and pragmatic?

aliases: who can make first aid kit camp
faq.answer: Any adventurer who studies First Aid and proves their skill can learn from Naleeia Tattermend in Shen'dar Village to make a First Aid Kit for camp.
faq.q: Can any adventurer craft a camping First Aid Kit?

sections.body: A journey across Azeroth can bring violence, wild beasts, and hazards of the land. First Aid lets you bind cuts and broken bones without relying only on spellcraft. A First Aid Kit at a wilderness camp gives you a place to tend injuries and help companions recover. Then you can prepare to travel on.
sections.title: Healing in the Wilderness

sections.body: In Shen'dar Village, Naleeia Tattermend teaches practitioners to make durable medical supplies for a campsite. She shares her techniques after you show that you know basic medical care.
sections.title: The Mentor of Shen'dar Village

summary: At Shen'dar Village, you seek care for injuries far from civilization. Naleeia Tattermend teaches skilled practitioners to prepare medical kits for a wilderness camp.
